translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Hebru
book.title: Hebru Maktumne taat ŋu siirtu ɗo gee ku Hebru

content: Buŋ kaaw a ŋaa pile botol ɗo geemir ŋuu un̰je ɗo jamiyner-ata. Ho kaawoy-at, taar tiya yoo ƴiriyta. Ampa-ak, zeeɗinte a minninko, yoo waanna goyaaɗo kaak yaa pakire a ŋa as ba aaro ho ŋa gediraaɗo un̰je ɗo wer-aka.
Asaan gi dorit kabarre ta samaane taat kaawa ɗo bi ka jamiyner-at ar kaak awalle ŋuur oki doriit ɗo goosiner. Kar locoŋ gay, kabarre-at uc usu asaan ŋu bal ooyin iŋ imaan.
Kar ginte kuuk aamin gay, gii un̰je ɗo jamiyner-ata. Ɗo bi ka jamiyner-at, Buŋ kaaw aman :

content.text: « Iŋ adir ka nige-ak, nu togiltu aman :
‟ Ŋu un̰jaaɗo tak-tak ɗo wer ka jamiyner

content: Kar sando, min Buŋ gaasiit riyoy ta kiliiginer, wer ka jamiyner-ak, ŋaar goy ko.
Ka seener, ɗo bi ka ƴiriy ta peesiriŋkar, wer rakki ɗo Kitamner ŋu kaaw aman : « Buŋ gaasit riyoy okintit iŋ mena bijigiƴ. Ɗo ƴiriy ta peesiriŋkar gay, ŋa jammiytu. »
Pey ɗo wer kaak gi garkiyiy diŋka-aŋka, Buŋ kaaw aman : « Ŋu un̰jaaɗo tak-tak ɗo wer ka jamiyner kaak nu siyiico. »
Ŋuur kuuk awalle dorit kabarre taat samaan-at baltu un̰je ɗo wer jamiyner-ak, asaan ŋu pooc karmiyin̰ Buŋ. Kar gay, goy gee kuuk yaa gedire un̰je ɗo wer-aka.
Ansii ko, Buŋ diytu pey wiktin taat gee yaa un̰je ɗo wer-aka ho ŋu koliit a « Ƴiriyta ». Ɗo bi ŋaar-ak ko, ɗo Kitamner, Buŋ kaawtu iŋ biy ka Dawuud aman :

content.text: « Ƴiriyta, ya ku cokiyaat gaaƴ ta Buŋdi,

content: Zer, ya ka seener, Zoozuwe iyiig aginiyte bal kaawo ɗo wer ka jamiyner-ak
, min taar-an, Buŋ kaawaaɗo pey ɗo bi ka ƴiriy ta pey.
Ampaa ko, ar kaak Buŋ jammiytu min ɗo riyoy ta kiliiginer iŋ ƴiriy ta peesiriŋkar, botol ta jamiyner ar taar-an goya ɗo gee ku Buŋdi oki.
Ka seener, gem kaak un̰je ɗo wer ka jamiyner kaak Buŋ siytu-ak, ŋaa jammiye min ɗo riyoy ar Buŋ jammiytu min tan̰ji.
Ansi-ak, zeeɗinte gii un̰je ɗo wer ka jamiyner-aka. Gininte iŋ ay botol pa waan minninte yaa aaɗe ta aginiyte kuuk tar ziŋkico ɗo wiktin taat ŋu pooctu karmiyin̰ Buŋ.

Ka seener, kaaw ta Buŋdi, taar ar maan kaak goy mento ho ta gina riyti iŋ gudurre. Ta ar *seepin kaak biŋkay paaɗ pakgig paaɗe ka ay seepine. Ta un̰ja ɗo gemor nam ta ɗeeɗiig gelbine iŋ ruwwine ho ta kiliig ŋaamiik ta kaasir iŋ loolo.
Pikirre iŋ kaawin kuuk goy ɗo adiy ka gemor oki, ta bayniigu ya ŋu samaane wala ŋu samaanno.
Min gamin okin̰co kuuk Buŋ kilgiytu, ginno kaak cigil ɗo uŋji. Kar ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi, ŋaar kaak gii ose biŋkiteŋ gay, gamin okin̰co-aŋ, ŋa ibingig rakki rakki ho ŋa talaagu waraŋ.
Iisa mee satkiner ka tatko
Min gi gin ko *mee satkiner ka tatik pakgig gay satkiner okin̰co, ŋaar-ak obinte bombo ɗo imaante taat gi gaariyo. Mee satkiner-ak coon ka samaaner. Ŋaar ko Iisa, Roŋ ka Buŋdi.

Ka seener, gi gin mee satkiner ka tatko kaak nec adiy yaa raɗin̰ji ɗo wiktin taat gudurrite sooɗa. Asaan iŋ gece kaak ŋu geciiga, ŋa aawit taaɓin okintit taat gi aawiyo, kar gay, ŋa bal gine zunuubinna kat bat.
Ŋaar-ak, sin̰jinte moota bal kolaw ɗo wer kaak Buŋ hokumiyiy iŋ barkiney. Eɗeŋ ko, Buŋ yaa tale aminduwte ho ŋaate bere barkiney-ata. Ampaa kat, ŋaate jorkinte ɗo wiktin taat ya duniin gasinte.
